name: io.github.olk/design-pattern-mcp
title: Design Pattern MCP
description: MCP server that provides design-pattern selection expertise to AI coding agents

runtimeArguments.name: --add-host
runtimeArguments.description: Makes a TEI embedder/reranker running on the Docker host reachable from the container (needed on Linux; already provided by Docker Desktop).

environmentVariables.name: DESIGN_PATTERN_GENERATOR_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the generator LLM (LiteLLM provider).

environmentVariables.name: DESIGN_PATTERN_GENERATOR_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: LiteLLM provider prefix, e.g. openai, anthropic, openrouter.

environmentVariables.name: DESIGN_PATTERN_GENERATOR_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model name, combined as <provider>/<model> via LiteLLM.

environmentVariables.name: DESIGN_PATTERN_PATTERN_DIRECTORY
environmentVariables.description: Directory with the catalog records (*.json main records plus per-language files). The image bakes the 438-record catalogue at /app/pattern.

environmentVariables.name: DESIGN_PATTERN_EMBEDDER_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Required: the dense retrieval leg embeds the 438-record catalogue during startup warmup and the server refuses to start when the endpoint is unreachable. TEI embeddings endpoint: on the Docker host use http://host.docker.internal:8080 (add --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway on Linux); on a shared Docker network use http://design-pattern-tei-embed:8080.

environmentVariables.name: DESIGN_PATTERN_EMBEDDER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the embedder. Keyless TEI accepts any non-empty value; use 'not-needed' there.

environmentVariables.name: DESIGN_PATTERN_RERANKER_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Required: retrieval runs a mandatory TEI cross-encoder rerank whenever the fused pool has more than one candidate. On the Docker host use http://host.docker.internal:8080; on a shared Docker network use http://design-pattern-tei-rerank:8080.
